scientific_integrity: Exact all-size conditional counting and AM–GM sign proof; finite exhaustive code supports, but does not replace, the all-size proof. Published component moments and Poisson limits credited. No independent evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Requires an even total of at least six distinguishable half-edges paired uniformly.
Parallel-edge statistic is the number of unordered pairs of edges joining distinct vertices; this is not the excess-edge count.
Does not assert a corresponding sign law for the conditioned simple graph or total half-edge count four.
Historical priority risk remains from broader indicator-moment methods and uninspected early surveys.
title: The degree-two boundary for loop–parallel-edge dependence in random configurations
